data.rationale: The proposal follows the same sequence as the true workflow (HN search, then GitHub repo, then a Lead note in the same format). It adds an unneeded github_repo parameter, assumes hn.algolia.com instead of the HN page's own Search box, and never says which tab to switch to. Even so, a browser automation could be built from it with only minor fixes.
